messages:
Maria: Quick coordination ask — can someone run a short sweep for API overhead covering streaming + function-calling + structured output? Need lightweight numbers (p50/p95) so we can triage the regression we saw in canary.
Kevin: I can run a small matrix tonight. Which model + harness flags?
Maria: Use rwd-7b-q4a (or closest quant) and run seq=512, qps=50, runs=4. Compare batch=1 and batch=4. Also run with structured_output=true vs false.
Sanjay: For structured output, please include both pre-serialized and post-serialized code paths — I suspect JSON boxing adds a few ms.
Maria: Good call. Bench command for bench-harness: 
```
./bench-run --model rwd-7b-q4a --seq 512 --qps 50 --runs 4 --batch 1,4 --streaming true --structured true --out s3://rwd-bench/1862345678/
```
Janet: Heads-up — my streaming header flush PR (#412) landed yesterday. Might change p50 a bit if harness toggles flush. Add `--enable-flush-toggle` to be safe.
Kevin: Ack. Will run both flush on/off. Scheduling now. tagging @Sanjay to remind on serializer variants.
bench-bot: Job queued: bench-1862345678-kevin-1 (ETA ~25m). Logs will appear in #bench-notifications.
Kevin: First pass finished. Short summary: streaming+funcall, batch=1: p50=44ms, p95=96ms. batch=4: p50=38ms, p95=120ms. Structured output adds ~8-11ms on average. Full table uploaded.
Maria: Can you attach the artifact link and include GPU util / CPU / KV-cache hit? Also include raw token counts.
Kevin: Uploaded artifacts: s3://rwd-bench/1862345678/artifacts.tar.gz. GPU util peaks 72%, avg 61%. KV cache hit ~84% on repeated prefixes. Token counts in logs.
Sanjay: I reproduced structured serializer locally — switching to pre-serialization (emit JSON string without extra walk) shaved ~4ms p50. Might be low-hanging win.
Alex: Quick ask for next run: toggle streaming=false to get sync baseline, and run a short microbench for function-call size (small vs large payload).
Maria: Perfect. I'll open a follow-up ticket to capture these action items and assign owners. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Janet: FYI I put a note on PR #412 to mark the flush flag as performance-sensitive.
Kevin: Will re-run with sync baseline tomorrow AM and post diff.
Maria: Great — leaving this thread open for artifacts + any surprises. :eyes:
